body.prompt: Use the supplied full Failure page only as style guidance. Generate one new independent UI sprite, never crop a screenshot. Dark near-black navy lacquer, subdued antique gold, fine Russian fairy-tale metalwork with very restrained highlights; no vivid yellow overall wash. True transparent exterior alpha; fully opaque painted interior. No text, letters, numbers, icons, people, scenery or checkerboard. All edges visible with narrow transparent margin. One wide horizontal failure title plaque, aspect about3.8:1 including a small central top sapphire crest. Large uninterrupted dark navy blank face for two lines of live lettering. Thin antique gold perimeter. Small centered top sapphire crest and delicate curling flourish ALONG THE TOP only. Straight restrained left and right short sides with clipped corners. Absolutely NO projecting side scrolls, wings, loops, side ornaments, handles or large side metal curls. Tiny bottom center gold point. Keep most area blank and dark.
